title: MAP Lab
text: The MAP Lab investigates the biological and environmental mechanisms underlying psychosis. We integrate neuroimaging, blood biomarkers, environmental risk factors and computational modelling to understand why psychosis develops and how it can be predicted earlier.

title: MAP Lab
text:
Our Research

Brain Imaging
Advanced MRI and spectroscopy to understand brain structure and chemistry.


Environment
How childhood adversity and the social environment influence brain development.


Blood Biomarkers
Inflammation, immune function and molecular markers associated with psychosis.


Prediction
Machine learning approaches for identifying individuals at greatest risk.
